anchors.paper_title: Neurons of the human subthalamic nucleus engage with local delta frequency processes during action cancellation
anchors.reason: The Nature Communications paper reports the STN LFP recordings during the stop-signal task. Its title matches the Figshare source dataset, and the authors are the same as the dataset's.

metadata.methods_description: Intraoperative microelectrode LFP was recorded from the STN while patients performed a stop-signal task. The authors' EEGLAB files at 250 Hz, high-pass filtered at 0.5 Hz, were converted to BrainVision float32 µV with unchanged values. Annotations were written to events.tsv.
